description:
PDF Text Extractor

Extract text from PDF URLs as JSON: full text, per-page text, metadata and optional tables, one row per document. Flags scanned image-only PDFs. From $2.00 per 1,000 extracted documents, platform usage included.

Pricing (pay per event, billed to your Apify account): Document with extracted text: $0.002.

Runs on Apify as subimpact/pdf-text-extractor.

_maxChargeUsd.description: Per-run spending cap in USD (default 0.5). Passed to Apify as the run option maxTotalChargeUsd, so the run stops when it reaches this charge.
_maxChargeUsd.title: Max charge (USD)

_maxItems.description: How many dataset items to return to the model (1-1000, default 50). Truncates the response only; it does not change what the Actor collects or charges for.
_maxItems.title: Max items returned

includePageTexts.description: Include pageTexts: one normalised text string per extracted page (empty string for image-only pages). Turn off for a smaller dataset when you only need the full text.
includePageTexts.title: Include per-page text

includeTables.description: Also extract tables with pdfplumber. Each table is returned as {"page": n, "rows": [[cell, ...], ...]}. Off by default because table detection is the slowest part of a run.
includeTables.title: Include tables

maxDocuments.description: Hard cap on document rows delivered in one run, counting every delivered row (including scanned, empty and error rows). The default of 100 keeps a run well under a dollar; at $0.002 per extracted document, 100 documents cost at most $0.20 plus platform usage.
maxDocuments.title: Max documents (rows)

maxFileSizeMb.description: Skip (and report as an error row) any PDF larger than this. The download is aborted as soon as it crosses the limit, so oversized files do not fill memory.
maxFileSizeMb.title: Max file size (MB)

maxPages.description: Extract at most this many pages from each PDF (default 200). pageCount still reports the real page count; pagesExtracted reports how many were read, and text/pageTexts/tables cover only those pages. Lower it for very large reports to cut run time.
maxPages.title: Max pages per document

proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. Most PDF hosts serve plain HTTP fine from Apify's datacenter IPs; enable Apify Proxy (or your own proxy URLs) if a publisher blocks the run. Proxy usage is billed by Apify as platform usage.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration

urls.description: One entry per PDF. A plain URL string or an object with a "url" field both work. Redirects are followed and the resolved URL is reported as finalUrl.
urls.title: PDF URLs

name: pdf_text
